```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
# Run this chunk ONCE in the console. Keep eval=FALSE so it does not
# run automatically each time you knit.
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "modelr", "broom"))
```

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(broom)
```
